must_identify.item: Only one of the two frontend pods fails (502/504, it cannot connect to its upstream), the other serves normally
The cause is the frontend-nginx ConfigMap upstream changed to api:8000; only the restarted pod has loaded it, the other still runs the old config

wrong_answers_asserted: api pods failing as the cause
notes: The RCA blames a transient cold-start race in which api pods were not yet Ready, and it declares the incident resolved. It never examined the frontend-nginx ConfigMap or compared the two frontend pods, so it missed the api:8000 upstream drift on the recreated pod. Its 502 evidence shows 10.96.17.70:8080, which suggests it only read logs from the healthy pod, frontend-76d98597b9-lwdln, and never fetched logs from the other frontend pod.
